description:
WHAT: Catalog of every PII and secret entity type, which ones run locally for free (pii_scan_text / pii_redact_text) vs only in the paid Actor (NER names/locations, street addresses, URL/PDF documents), redaction styles, and the price of every paid tool in this server.
WHEN: Before pii_scan_text / pii_redact_text to pick entityTypes, or to explain coverage and costs to a user.
WHEN NOT: To actually scan text (pii_scan_text) or redact it (pii_redact_text).
COST: Free; no token.
RETURNS: One catalog object; local:true marks the detectors the free tools run (see PARAMETERS).
BEHAVIOR: No network calls; local static catalog, instant (<10 ms). No rate limits.
PARAMETERS: None: call with an empty object {}; the catalog is always complete and cannot be filtered. Its output feeds other tools' parameters: copy detector "type" values verbatim into entityTypes of pii_scan_text / pii_redact_text (only rows with local:true can match there) or pii_guard_documents (all rows, incl. PERSON / LOCATION / STREET_ADDRESS); redaction_styles keys are the allowed redactionStyle values.
EXAMPLE: {} -> {"detectors":[{"type":"AWS_ACCESS_KEY","category":"secret","local":true},...]}
name: pii_list_detectors
title: List PII/secret detectors and pricing (free)
